decisions: Current compiled CSharp FixedArrays and DynamicArrays factories pass ordered ID/element/length, independent output and missing-element checks in exporter78. Existing compiler product is reused with matching source hashes; no CSharp behavior change is required.

SLG storage_registration already reads the two shared catalogs but discards enum-member coordinates, while prepared registration copies five array shapes. Extract one bounded schema decoder with integer source spans into TypeNamePolicy. Both semantic storage registration and compatibility alias construction consume it.

Preserve empty/trailing/missing-field/digit/Int32 overflow rejection and all-before-mutation semantic registration. Preserve dynamic semantic length -1 versus compatibility shape length0. Build dynamic aliases before fixed aliases to retain the existing prepared alias order. Resolve type names through shared builtin and intrinsic catalogs plus generated TypeId members; no numeric identity, member spelling or array lengths copied.

Focused runtime must compare actual compiled CSharp factory shapes, exact source spans and malformed/boundary schemas, and retain the original storage registration missing-element/idempotence controls. Do not run original1999/profile/Stage.
